completion_data.completion_summary: Wired events-append.sh up as the unified event store's first real caller: instrumented all four skill-base.sh lifecycle functions and orchestrator-postflight.sh's status resolution with non-blocking timed event emissions, added PostToolUse (events-log-artifact.sh) and Stop/SubagentStop (events-log-lifecycle.sh) logger hooks, registered both in manifest.json/root-files/settings.json, and synced EXTENSION.md's hook count and capability list.

memory_candidates.content: specs/errors.json's schema is a top-level object {"errors": [...]}, not a bare JSON array. When cross-linking a session's most recent error entry, use jq '.errors[]? | select(.context.session_id == $sid) | ...' -- select(.errors[]) directly on the file will error if you assume a bare array.

Claude Code Stop/SubagentStop hook stdin never carries a workflow session_id or task number directly. The established correlation chain in this repo is: SubagentStop -> find the .postflight-pending marker file (which DOES carry session_id/skill/operation) via `find specs -maxdepth 3 -name ".postflight-pending"`; Stop -> read .claude/tmp/workflow-active (format: "<task_number> <timestamp>", written by update-task-status.sh preflight) for a task number, falling back to a task-number regex over last_assistant_message (mirror memory-nudge.sh), then resolve session_id by looking up that task number against specs/state.json's active_projects[].session_id (populated on every preflight). If no session_id can be resolved this way, exit {} cleanly rather than emitting a sessionless event.

To verify a batch of JSONL event lines against context/schemas/events-schema.json in a scratch e2e test, use Python's jsonschema.Draft7Validator(schema).iter_errors(obj) per parsed line rather than hand-rolled jq field checks -- it directly enforces the pattern/enum/required constraints (e.g. event_id's evt_{ms}_{6} pattern, session_id's sess_{ts}_{alnum} pattern, category's closed enum) with precise error messages, catching test-fixture mistakes (like a non-conforming session_id) immediately.
